summary: Linear membership test over a fixed-stride list. When a2 is non-zero, walks records starting at the head this[3] (this+0x0C), advancing by 160 bytes per element, bounded by the count this[4] (this+0x10); returns 1 if a record address equals a2 and 0 otherwise, including the empty-list and null-argument cases.

operations.description: Initialize result to 0 as the not-found default.
If a2 is zero, skip the search and return 0.
Load the list length v3 from this[4] (this+0x10) and reset the visited counter v4 to 0.
If v3 is not greater than 0, the empty-list case returns 0 without iterating.
Iterate i starting at this[3] (this+0x0C), advancing by 160 bytes per step, until i equals a2.
Inside the loop, if ++v4 >= v3 (the count limit is reached without a match), return 0.
Return 1 when an element whose address equals a2 is found.

unresolved: Element record type and what the 160-byte stride contains.
Relationship between the head at this+0x0C and the length at this+0x10.
Whether records are a contiguous array or another layout (the loop advances by a constant 160-byte stride, implying contiguous records).
